messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering-alert — anomalous token-count drift detected for multiple customers in EU region. auto-escalation to on-call (sev: high). link: https://dash.redwood.internal/meters/alerts/1718604321 :rotating_light:
kevin_oncall: Acked. I'm on call, grabbing dashboard now.
mike_sre: seeing an abrupt +40% token delta vs expected for the 14:00-14:05 window. Dashboard shows emitter lag + retries. :eyes:
ellen_prod: two customers reported overage emails ~14:10 UTC. CS tickets inbound (TKT-4532, TKT-4533). Notified billing team.
billing_ops: confirmed: overage flagging pipeline picked up inflated counts from the proxy retry window. suspect duplicate emitter records. pausing automated overage notifications for affected accounts now.
kevin_oncall: Command run: `billing-ctl pause-notifications --scope=eu-region --reason="emit-dup-drift"` — completed. :white_check_mark:
dana_cs: Thanks — I'll reply to the two customers that we're investigating and suppress any billing alerts until resolved.
mike_sre: quick check: running query to detect dup keys —
```
SELECT emitter_id, count(*) as cnt
FROM token_emitter_logs
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-17T14:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-17T14:10:00Z'
GROUP BY emitter_id
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
Found a handful of emitter_ids with dup spikes. Suspect a retry loop in proxy v2.3.4.
billing_ops: Starting short-term rollback of per-window aggregates to snapshot @14:00. This will remove inflated deltas. Executing safe rollback + write-lock. ETA 7m.
kevin_oncall: Rolling mitigation plan: 1) pause notifications (done) 2) rollback window aggregates to 14:00 snapshot (in progress) 3) block proxy retries for emitters (config toggle) 4) follow-up reconcile backfill job.
ellen_prod: Are there any customer finance impacts we need to flag? Might need to proactively offer credit if invoices already issued.
billing_ops: No invoices issued yet for the window, only email flags. We'll hold invoice runs and mark the window "recon-pending".
mike_sre: rollback finished, aggregated counts reverted to 14:00 snapshot. Running verification.
kevin_oncall: Verification: token totals normalized within expected variance (<2%). Monitoring IG: https://dash.redwood.internal/meters/overview?range=15m :thumbsup:
dana_cs: CS notified both customers that alerts were suppressed and counts are being corrected. They appreciated the quick update.
ellen_prod: Opening follow-up ticket to root-cause: PROJ-871, assign to eng-runtime and eng-infra. We should also schedule a postmortem if RMSE > threshold.
billing_ops: Leaving note: will run full reconcile backfill tonight to ensure no residual dup counts. Will attach reconciliation report to PROJ-871.
mike_sre: Temporary mitigation: we also toggled `proxy.retry.enabled=false` for the service in eu staging and are rolling to canary in prod.
kevin_oncall: Good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and hand off to morning oncall for follow-through. If anything changes, we re-open pager.
incident-bot: Incident 1718604321 status: mitigation-applied. assigned: kevin_oncall, mike_sre, billing_ops. next update scheduled 15m.
kevin_oncall: Closing this thread for live mitigation — not resolved, but stable. Follow-up ticket PROJ-871 created. :lock:
